name: New Alden
tagline: The original. A colonial landing, a numbered grid, and Broadway cutting both.

name: Kestrel Point
tagline: A narrow peninsula — frontage is scarce and the only cheap land is at the tip.

name: Marrow Bay
tagline: A crescent around a deep bay; three grids that refuse to agree.

name: Thorne Island
tagline: An island. No hinterland, no cheap edge — build up or buy somebody out.

name: Calder Falls
tagline: A mill town. Value runs uphill, away from the working river.

name: Sable Harbor
tagline: A hooked harbor — more waterfront than land behind it.
